authorRole: SECURITY SOURCE AUTHOR (Muse Wonder fallback, user-confirmed). These are author positions only: no independent approval, no vote by any other party is fabricated, and no execution authority is granted.

positions.clause: The adapter must execute the actual already compiled APPLIED B9 c2.c2.mint wrapper (shared compiledCode across c2.c2.mint/spend/else, parameters none) and its Issue redeemer with a raw PlutusV3 ScriptContext; it must not manually rebuild the claim.issue predicate or substitute a handwritten verifier.
positions.rationale: validators/c2.ak mint Issue delegates to claim.issue; b9-applied.json shows one compiledCode/hash for the three c2 titles. The adapter only extracts that compiledCode into script.hex and supplies Data terms.

positions.clause: The actual policy used in ScriptInfo::Minting, the claim output script credential, and the mint/output value maps must be the compiled artifact identity 6a4b67e7d46dbada1b4f49dd324018324b60b13bebbeb6f33d9d59c1, classified tool-declared; the K9 locally chosen a2a2.. policy must not be carried into K10.
positions.rationale: claim.issue requires holder == policy_id and singleton policy mint; using any other policy would not exercise the compiled wrapper's own binding. K9's builder explicitly states a2a2.. is not the compiled hash.

positions.clause: No independent script-hash claim is made: the source-grounded formula stops at ast.rs SerializableProgram -> conway::PlutusScript::<3>(program.to_cbor()).compute_hash(), and the Pallas ComputeHash implementation is absent from the mirror; the exact gap is pallas-primitives 0.35.1 / pallas-traverse 0.35.1 (Cargo.lock) ComputeHash for PlutusScript, to be acquired as bounded primary source before any independent-hash assertion.
positions.rationale: ast.rs:151-187 and Cargo.lock:2463-2494 were read; the implementing crate bodies are not indexed inputs. Inventing the discriminator/CBOR-layer formula would be an unsupported normative claim.

positions.clause: The claim token name is blake2b-256 of the PlutusData CBOR of the EnvV2 datum, computed by a minimal encoder grounded in stdlib cbor.ak serialise examples/decoder and uplc convert_constr_to_tag, verified against a field-by-field frozen positive preimage; byte strings over 64 bytes (chunked 0x5f serialise_data path) fail closed because that encoding is not independently sourced here and is unreachable for the frozen envelopes (all byte fields <=32 bytes).
positions.rationale: claim.ak:25, cbor.ak:84-107/138-253, runtime.rs:2299-2309. VK (488B) and statement (721B) never enter the hashed datum; they travel as Data B terms in the redeemer, parsed by uplc parser.rs, so no unsourced chunking is silently used.

positions.clause: The ScriptContext must be the PlutusV3 shape of uplc tx/to_plutus_data.rs: Constr 0 [16-field TxInfo, Issue redeemer, ScriptInfo::Minting], V3 bare-Coin fee, zero-Ada-omitted value maps, InlineDatum as Constr 2, reference script None, interval.everything validity range, bare-bytes transaction id, empty votes/treasury/donation exactly as sourced; no V2 tuple or fake context may be used.
positions.rationale: to_plutus_data.rs TxInfo::V3 branch, Output/Value/Option/TimeRange/ScriptInfo impls and stdlib transaction.ak/script_context.ak/address.ak/interval.ak were read line-by-line for every field the adapter emits.

positions.clause: Exactly seven tests are frozen before execution: T1 genuine accepts with unit result; T2/T3 coherent N1/N2 envelope rebuilds are refused by the pairing, not an earlier guard; T4 N3 A/C-swapped proof is refused by the pairing; T5 quantity 2, T6 token-name bit-flip and T7 VK-digest bit-flip are refused at their named first guards; compiled-wrapper refusals are non-zero eval exits, never K9-style Bool false or string-searched PASS labels.
positions.rationale: Mirrors the adopted K9 coherent-tamper construction (k9_genuine_c2_consumer_test.ak) while translating its Bool expectations to the eval.rs success/error contract (single JSON on exit 0; exit 1 with stderr on error).

positions.clause: This source authorizes nothing: a fresh full source/effect audit, ordinary data generation, a fresh actual-input review and a separate new exact bounded native AUTH (one attempt per invocation, zero retries, read-only tool mount, public fresh data only) are each required before the compiled wrapper is executed; no current authority is inherited from the K8/K9 runs.
positions.rationale: EXECUTION-PROPOSAL.json states the exact aiken uplc eval --cbor argv from eval.rs and preserves failures verbatim. Native operator/AUTH is deliberately not one of these five source files.

positions.clause: The locally constructed context (fabricated 2222../555.. fixtures, unbound 2030 expiry, zero fee, empty inputs) supports no ledger, fee, conservation, admission, wallet, signing or Preprod claim, and no live mint may use the fabricated claimant/outref; real Preprod requires a newly reviewed context/proof/identity pipeline, and the public wallet setup remains a separate task.
positions.rationale: K9 adoption records the same limits for the identical fixture values; claim.issue itself does not authenticate claimant, outref, expiry or unspentness. Local VM cpu/mem are not ledger ExUnits, and mainnet/Preprod maxTxSize/ExUnits are unknown from these inputs.
